items.question: How long does implementation take?
items.answer: Typical deployment takes 2-4 weeks including carrier registration, system integration, and testing. We provide dedicated support throughout the process.

items.question: Which carriers support Branded Calling?
items.answer: We support all major carriers including Etisalat, Du, STC, Mobily, Zain, Ooredoo, and Omantel with continuous expansion to additional networks.

items.question: How does spam protection work?
items.answer: Our AI system monitors call patterns, maintains carrier relationships, and proactively prevents spam flagging through intelligent reputation management.

items.question: Is there a minimum call volume requirement?
items.answer: No minimum volume required. Our solution scales from small businesses to enterprise operations handling millions of calls monthly.

items.question: Can I customize branding for different campaigns?
items.answer: Yes, you can create multiple branded identities for different departments, campaigns, or call purposes with dynamic display rules.
